full_page.content:
1947, Nov. 4
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten postcard by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Blessed be God in all His designs!
November 4th. Again many thanks for your generous favor of October 16th. May the dear Lord bless you for same. Thank you specially for enrolling me. Yours must make about a dozen perpetual enrollments I've had this Jubilee year, and I have no idea how often I've been enrolled annually. The continued favors we have reported as through this association gives me an appreciation for such enrollments that I could hardly have otherwise. Thanks be to God. ... As to taking children for adoption, I look at that according to our dear Lord's own appreciation: "What you have done for the least of my brethren You have done to me." -- It is getting late now: So. I'll say Good Night for the present ....
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(written on the picture side of the postcard)
(printed) SAINT FELIX CAPUCHIN FRIARY, HUNTINGTON, IND.
(handwritten) and clerical novitiate. This year we have 24 promising novices. Thanks be to God. We could place a hundred more priests if we had them -- in home and foreign missions.
P.S. Congratulations on your joining the privileged Family of the Franciscans.
( Postscript appears on back of envelope)
Original in possession of: Mrs. Elizabeth O'Flaherty 1382 Nottingham Grosse Pte., MI. 48230
